title: Core: AS2 comma operator and sequence expressions
description: Verify AS2 comma operator and expression sequences compile: (a++, b++, c), for(var i=0, j=0; i<10; i++, j++), var x=1, y=2 (multiple declarations). Also verify that void expressions compile: void fn(). Tests in packages/core/src/as2/__tests__/seqexpr.test.ts.
